title.zh: 通过任务ID获取离线任务分析结果
title.en: Retrieve offline task analysis results by task ID

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO产品的收费方式和价格。

前提条件
1. 已开通通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO服务。
2. 已创建应用：应用中心完成通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用创建，并获取到APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID：[获取APP-ID和WORKSPACE-ID](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/obtain-api-key-app-id-and-workspace-id?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.310f281ffuUD8V)。
descriptions.en:
Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of CCAI-Dialogue Analysis AIO.

Before you begin
1. CCAI-Dialogue Analysis AIO is activated.
2. An application is created: Create a CCAI-Dialogue Analysis AIO application in the application center and obtain the APP-ID and WORKSPACE-ID. For more information, see [Obtain APP-ID and WORKSPACE-ID](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/developer-reference/obtain-api-key-app-id-and-workspace-id).
